'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]], [[501.V2 variant]]
*****[[Alberta]] reports the first case of the new variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] from [[South Africa]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/alberta-reports-what-could-be-canada-s-first-case-of-covid-19-variant-first-found-in-south-africa-1.5866938 (CBC)] 
****[[Canada]] reports a record of 9,197 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7564840/coronavirus-update-canada-jan-8/ (Global News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
******[[New York City Police Commissioner]] [[Dermot Shea]] tests positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://patch.com/new-york/new-york-city/nypd-commissioner-dermot-shea-tests-positive-coronavirus (Patch.com)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
*****[[Governor of California|California Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] sets a goal of vaccinating 1 million people by January 17. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2021-01-08/california-government-million-vaccinations-newsom-promise-covid-19 (''The Los Angeles Times'')]
****[[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]] says he will plan to speed up the release of [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] doses. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/health/2021/01/08/covid-biden-plans-release-all-vaccines-not-hold-second-dose/6596334002/ (''USA Today'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[List of Ministers of Health of the Republic of Cyprus|Health Minister]] Constantinos Ioannou announces a second nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] for the [[Cyprus|country]] that will last three weeks beginning January 10 in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210108-cyprus-imposes-second-nationwide-virus-lockdown (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record 1,188 deaths in the past 24 hours, according to data from the [[Robert Koch Institute]], bringing the nationwide death toll to 38,795. [https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/deutschland-corona-todesfaelle-101.html (''Taggeschau'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] extends their nationwide lockdown until January 18 but will allow kindergartens, elementary schools and nurseries to reopen on January 11. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/261025/article/ekathimerini/news/lockdown-extended-for-a-week-to-jan-18 (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] reports a record 8,248 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 135,884. [https://www.irishexaminer.com/news/arid-40203575.html (''Irish Examiner'')]
****[[Chief Medical Officer (Ireland)|Chief Medical Officer]] [[Tony Holohan]] announces that three cases of the [[South Africa]]n variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] named [[501.V2 variant]] have been detected in Ireland. All of the people had travelled to South Africa. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/health/covid-19-south-african-strain-detected-for-first-time-in-ireland-1.4453160 (''The Irish Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a new daily record of 10,176 cases, bringing the nationwide cumulative total of confirmed cases to 466,709. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/312_DGS_boletim_20210108.pdf (DGS)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****The [[Riksdag]] passes a new law that gives the [[Government of Sweden|government]] power to impose COVID-19-related lockdowns, such as ordering certain businesses to close or prohibiting public gatherings of certain sizes. The law will take effect on January 10. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2021/01/08/sweden-coronavirus-lockdown-law/ (''The Washington Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in London]]
*****[[Mayor of London|London mayor]] [[Sadiq Khan]] declares a "major incident" in the capital due to a rise in the number of cases that threatens to overwhelm hospitals. [https://news.sky.com/story/covid-19-major-incident-declared-in-london-due-to-hospital-pressure-12182329 (Sky News)]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record 68,053 new confirmed cases and 1,325 deaths in the past 24 hours. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-55594107 (BBC News)]
****The [[Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency]] approves a [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] made by [[Moderna]] for use in the UK. This comes after clinical trials found the vaccine had an efficacy of 94.1% and 100% for severe cases. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk/how-does-moderna-covid-vaccine-work-uk-b374169.html (''Evening Standard'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bhutan]]
****[[Bhutan]] reports its first death from COVID-19 after a 34-year-old man with chronic [[liver disease]] and renal failure, who tested positive for COVID-19, died in a hospital in [[Thimphu]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-bhutan/bhutan-reports-first-covid-19-death-idUSKBN29D13B (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 10,617 new cases. It is the first time that the country has reported more than 10,000 cases and brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 808,340. [https://nasional.kompas.com/read/2021/01/08/16175981/update-10617-pasien-kasus-baru-covid-19-kembali-pecahkan-rekor (''Kompas'')]
****The [[Indonesian Ulema Council]] gives a religious approval for use of [[Sinovac Biotech]]'s [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]], deeming it ''[[halal]]'', or permissible under Islam. [https://www.dw.com/en/indonesia-clerics-declare-china-covid-vaccine-halal/a-56169997 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Supreme Leader of Iran|Supreme Leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]] calls for a ban on the American [[Pfizer]] and British [[AstraZeneca]] vaccines. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-leader-bans-covid-vaccines-from-uk-and-us/a-56168501 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record 7,841 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20210108_40/ (NHK World)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 16 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 537. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/01/08/malaysia-records-new-daily-high-of-16-deaths-2641-covid-19-cases/1938640 (''Malay Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[King of Saudi Arabia|King]] [[Salman of Saudi Arabia|Salman]] receives the first dose of [[Pfizer]]'s [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] in [[Neom]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1789401/saudi-arabia (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Prime Minister of Singapore|Prime Minister]] [[Lee Hsien Loong]] receives a [[COVID-19 vaccine]] as the country begins a nationwide vaccination campaign in public health institutions. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/politics/pm-lee-receives-covid-19-vaccine-as-singapore-starts-nationwide-vaccination-drive (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[Brazil]] surpasses 8 million cases of COVID-19, becoming the third country to do so after the [[United States]] and [[India]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/brazil-total-coronavirus-cases-top-8-million--health-ministry-13924498 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Peru]] reports the first case of the new variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] from the [[United Kingdom]] in a citizen who resides in [[Lima]] and had attended a family reunion days before [[Christmas]]. [https://andina.pe/ingles/noticia-peru-reports-first-case-of-covid19-variant-found-in-uk-829105.aspx (Andina)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
***[[Brisbane]] is placed into lockdown for three days in order to reduce the spread of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] after a cleaner at a hotel quarantine site was diagnosed with a known variant of concern. The [[Northern Territory]] and [[Tasmania]] ban all travellers from Brisbane. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-01-08/tasmania-declares-greater-brisbane-a-high-risk-coroanvirus-area/13041818 (ABC Australia)] [https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/7078494/three-day-lockdown-for-greater-brisbane/?cs=14264 (''The Canberra Times'')] [https://www.news.com.au/travel/travel-updates/health-safety/tasmania-declares-greater-brisbane-a-high-risk-area-orders-travellers-to-quarantine/news-story/34d5d7e032ef1df92ff1e177f7b8f31d (News.com.au)]
***[[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] announces that anyone coming into [[Australia]] must present a negative [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 test]] prior to their departure and that masks will be mandatory on all domestic and international [[passenger flights]]. The caps on international arrivals will also be reduced for the next month. [https://www.9news.com.au/national/coronavirus-australia-scott-morrison-national-cabinet-changed-to-domestic-international-travel-caps-on-arrivals/a0798769-9be1-4996-86ce-704b7a715496 (9 News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***[[South Africa]] reports a record 21,980 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,192,570. [https://www.timeslive.co.za/news/south-africa/2021-01-08-sa-hits-new-covid-19-infection-record-with-21980-new-cases-in-24-hours/ (''Timeslive'')]
**[[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Tozinameran]], [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccine|Vaccine]] developer [[Pfizer]] announces that lab studies have concluded that the joint Pfizer–[[BioNTech]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] remains effective against mutation variants of the SARS-CoV-2 virus, including [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]] and the [[501.V2 variant]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/health-55587320 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
**[[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Criminal charges brought in the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
***[[Richard Barnett (Capitol rioter)|The man]] photographed sitting at [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]]'s desk during the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|storming]] of the [[United States Capitol]] is arrested in [[Little Rock, Arkansas|Little Rock]], [[Arkansas]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/richard-barnett-man-seen-sitting-nancy-pelosis-desk-arrested-arkansas-1560128 (''Newsweek'')]
***The [[United States Department of Justice|Department of Justice]] [[Indictment#United States|indicts]] 15 people involved in the assault on the Capitol. The department says that more charges are expected. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/united-states/us-justice-department-indicts-15-over-capitol-violence (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
***The [[United States Attorney for the District of Columbia]] announces that [[West Virginia House of Delegates|West Virginia delegate]] [[Derrick Evans (politician)|Derrick Evans]] is expected to face charges for illegally entering the Capitol. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/derrick-evans-arrested-west-virginia-federal-charges-capitol-riot/ (CBS News)]
*[[Trial of Benjamin Netanyahu]]
**Amid another quarantine lockdown, the next hearing in the trial of current [[Israel]]i [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] is postponed. Netanyahu stands accused, in three separate ongoing cases, of a litany of corruption accusations, including bribery, breach of trust, and fraud. [https://apnews.com/article/international-news-israel-coronavirus-pandemic-benjamin-netanyahu-jerusalem-2512c3ed3195c26b17e0a15470f05f1e (AP)]
*[[2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings]]
**The [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Department of Justice]] [[criminal charge|charges]] three [[Sri Lanka]]n nationals with "[[Providing material support for terrorism|providing material support]] to a [[United States Department of State list of Foreign Terrorist Organizations|designated foreign terrorist organization]]" in the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]]-claimed bombings. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/jan/09/us-charges-three-sri-lankans-over-role-in-2019-isis-easter-attacks (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*A court in [[Pakistan]] sentences [[Zakiur Rehman Lakhvi]] to five years in prison on [[terrorism in Pakistan|terrorism]] financing charges. Lakhvi, a senior member of the group [[Lashkar-e-Taiba]], is accused of the [[2008 Mumbai attacks]], though he was convicted of unrelated charges. [[India]] and the United States welcome the verdict but ask that he be tried for the attacks. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-court/pakistan-sentences-lakhvi-to-five-years-for-terrorism-financing-idUSKBN29D16J?il=0 (Reuters)]
*A court in Pakistan sentences three people to death and a college teacher to 10 years in prison for [[blasphemy in Pakistan|blasphemy]]. Those convicted can now appeal to higher courts and ask for clemency from the [[President of Pakistan|President]]. [[human rights in Pakistan|Human rights]] groups say that the law persecutes [[religious minorities in Pakistan|religious minorities]] including [[Shia Islam|Shias]] and the [[Ahmadiyya]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/8/pakistan-court-sentences-three-to-death-for-blasphemy (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020 United States elections]]
**[[Presidential transition of Joe Biden]]
***[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that he will not attend the [[Inauguration of Joe Biden|inauguration ceremony]] of [[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]]. Trump will be the first president to choose not to attend their elected successor's inauguration since [[Andrew Johnson]] in [[First inauguration of Ulysses S. Grant|1869]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/01/08/politics/donald-trump-next-steps/index.html (CNN)]
***Outgoing [[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] meets with incoming Secretary of State [[Antony Blinken]] for the first time in an effort to ensure an [[Peaceful transition of power|orderly transition of power]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/01/08/pompeo-holds-meeting-with-bidens-secretary-of-state-nominee.html (CNBC)] 
**[[2020–21 United States Senate election in Georgia]]
***Former [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[David Perdue]] [[Concession (politics)|concedes]] to [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] challenger [[Jon Ossoff]]. His concession formally guarantees the Democrats a majority in the [[United States Senate]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/01/08/politics/perdue-concedes-georgia-senate-race-ossoff/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Pope Francis]] appoints Vincenzo Buonomo as Head of the [[Disciplinary Commission of the Roman Curia]], becoming the first [[Laity|layperson]] to hold the position. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/first-lay-head-of-disciplinary-commission-at-roman-curia-appointed-19711 (Catholic News Agency)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
**[[Twitter suspensions]]
***[[Social media use by Donald Trump|Donald Trump on social media]]
****[[Twitter]] permanently [[Twitter suspensions|suspends]] Donald Trump's account. According to Twitter, he was suspended to end "the risk of further incitement of violence." [https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/twitter-permanently-bans-president-donald-trump-n1253588 (NBC News)]
***Twitter also suspends the accounts of former [[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Advisor]] [[Michael Flynn]], American attorney [[Sidney Powell]], and former [[8chan|8kun]] administrator [[Ron Watkins]] for spreading content related to the [[QAnon]] conspiracy theory. [https://thehill.com/policy/technology/533424-twitter-permanently-suspends-michael-flynn-sidney-powell-and-others (''The Hill'')]
**[[Google]] announces that it will suspend [[Parler]] from their [[Google#Play Store on Android|Play Store]] due to concerns of incitement of violence. [[Apple Inc.|Apple]] also threatens to follow suit after 24 hours following the [[2021 storming of the United States Capitol|storming]] of the Capitol. [https://amp.theguardian.com/us-news/2021/jan/09/google-suspends-parler-social-network-app-over-incitement-to-violence (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-apple-parler/apple-threatens-to-remove-parler-social-networking-service-from-app-store-idUSKBN29D34N?source=techstories.org (Reuters)]
